title: Improved replay reliability for recent failed queries
points: Fixed mixed acronym/company routing so SBP and STI are treated as financing context when a valid company scope is present.
Added a deterministic bare-ticker overview path for prompts such as GHNI, returning current market data and latest annual/quarterly financials without a slow document-analysis pass.
Added a deterministic report-source path for simple PDF/report link follow-ups, returning the latest filing page-level PDF links for the scoped ticker.
